title: Best Tax Prep Service 2026
description: H&R Block, Jackson Hewitt, TurboTax Live, Local CPA, and VITA — for complex tax returns.
lede: Five tax prep services compared by cost, expertise, and audit support.
methodology: Submitted same complex return to each. Compared final tax, prep time, cost.

sections.heading: When to use professional tax prep
paragraphs: Self-employed, rental property, multi-state benefit most. Simple W-2 fine with software.

faqs.a: CPA for self-employment, rental, multi-state. Software for W-2 + simple deductions.

turbotax-live-full-service.review: Online video calls with tax pro, $200-400.

local-cpa.review: Local CPA for self-employed, rental, business. $300-1,500+.

pinDescription: Best tax prep service 2026: H&R Block vs. Jackson Hewitt vs. TurboTax Live vs. CPA vs. VITA.
